labelled_by: Cursor agent (AI assistant), by reading stored chunk text in PostgreSQL
method: Each question was written after reading the bid's source documents (as stored chunk text).
Each answer pattern is the wording in the source that answers the question. Every chunk whose text matches it is labelled relevant, with the matched text stored as evidence.
Grade 2: the chunk states the answer. Grade 1: the chunk is related context that partly answers the question.
Text and table chunks of the same page are both labelled when both contain the answer.
Labels were not taken from the search engine under evaluation.
